answer: Replica Decay Issuance. Each identity accrues reputation on a vine of sequential work receipts; cloning copies history but not the timestamps, so only one branch survives verification. A new clone must re-earn trust from a relic checkpoint, paying full compute plus a forfeited escrow that decays to zero if unused. Attack cost per sybil exceeds expected payout, since the fable of shared history collapses under challenge.
